remarks: ONE LEVEL LIVING! Newer, Spacious & Privately located in Desirable Palmer Square - Mere Steps and you're on the Path to the popular public Golf Course! Enjoy life in a Pet Friendly community with economic gas heat, central air + No ADDITIONAL FEES! This well appointed, immaculate home with private entrance & extra windows also offers designer features such as: Laminate flooring, gourmet kitchen w/stainless steel appliances & granite counter tops and a sparkling bath with subway tile! Enjoy an open living/dining area and in-unit washer/dryer. Come see this private cheerful space, wonderfully situated within the complex! Palmer Square is a meticulously maintained community providing: On-Site Management, 24-Hour Security & Parking for 2-Cars. Pets are welcome with the following guidelines 2 Dogs 35 Lbs., 1 Dog 60 lbs., or 1-dog + 1-Cat or 2-Cats OK. $300 fully refundable pet deposit per pet required. Palmer Square is a No Smoking Community. Interested parties please complete a Palmer Square application uploaded in supplements, and supply a credit check through Rentspree or Applyconnect only.
